subject: DIVIDE statement
notes: Citation validated: `cite.py --check 14.9.12.4 "The dividend is identifier-2 or literal-2. The divisor is identifier-1 or literal-1"` -> OK, GR 2). DERIVED FIRST: in EVERY format the dividend is the id-2/lit-2 slot and the divisor the id-1/lit-1 slot — which means INTO's first operand is the DIVISOR and BY's first operand is the DIVIDEND, the one role-mapping a compiler can silently invert. READ: BindDivide binds `var a = host.Expr.BindExpr(aCtx)` with the comment 'INTO: the divisor; BY: the dividend', then INTO-with-GIVING returns `BoundDivideGiving(dividendX, a, ...)` where dividendX = BindExpr(into.receiversOrSendingOperand()) and BY-with-GIVING returns `BoundDivideGiving(a, divisorX, ...)` where divisorX = BindExpr(byPhrase.sendingOperand()); the record is `BoundDivideGiving(BoundExpr Dividend, BoundExpr Divisor, ...)`, so both map correctly. The REMAINDER branch repeats the same mapping through its two conditional expressions (`dividend = div.divideIntoPhrase() is { } i ? BindExpr(i.receiversOrSendingOperand()) : a` / `divisor = div.divideIntoPhrase() is not null ? a : div.divideByPhrase() is { } b ? BindExpr(b.sendingOperand()) : a`) — checked arm by arm, both arms correct. Format 1 (no GIVING) makes each identifier-2 both dividend and receiver: EmitDivide is called with dividend null and reads `num.FieldNum(r.Place)` per receiver — the identifier-2-as-dividend reading. GR2b (item identification, content of the resulting item) — every identifier operand binds to a BoundNumRef Place and renders through PlaceRenderer, so subscripts/ref-mods are evaluated where the operand is read; with more than one receiver both operands are materialized into locals by ArithmeticEmitter.Snapshot before any store (14.7.7 GR4 + NOTE 3). GR2c (literal value) — a literal operand binds through ExpressionBinder.NumLiteral to BoundNumLiteral, and the literal-after-INTO case (`DIVIDE 3 INTO 10 GIVING Q`) reaches it through BindOperandExprCore's LiteralContext arm. TEST: the enabled golden tests/conformance/2023/pb45_function_in_sending_operands.cob writes BOTH `DIVIDE FUNCTION SQRT(W-Z) INTO W-Q GIVING W-R` and `DIVIDE W-Q BY FUNCTION SQRT(W-Z) GIVING W-R` with the hand-derived comment '9 / 2 = 4 (truncated)' and a .out — the same numeric answer from the two opposite operand orders is exactly the discriminating test for this role mapping. RoundedDifferentialTests.DivideGivingRounded_ModeIs adds `DIVIDE 10 INTO 25 GIVING R` = 25/10, pinning that the INTO operand is the divisor. || UPHELD (independent evidence, with the test claim re-measured): I re-derived GR2 from specs/ISO_COBOL.md:23659-23665 and then read ArithmeticBinder.BindDivide arm by arm without looking at the adjudicator's mapping first — Format 1 BoundDivideInto(a=divisor, intoRecv), Format 2 Dividend=BindExpr(into.receiversOrSendingOperand()), Divisor=a, Format 3 Dividend=a, Divisor=BindExpr(byPhrase.sendingOperand()), Format 4 dividend=BindExpr(i.receiversOrSendingOperand()), divisor=a, Format 5 dividend=a, divisor=BindExpr(b.sendingOperand()). All five correct against the figures at :23527-23630. The pb45 evidence is genuinely DISCRIMINATING and I verified the operands from the source (W-Z=4 so SQRT=2, W-Q=9) and the .out (DIV-INTO=0004, DIV-BY=0004): an inverted INTO mapping would print 0000 (2/9 truncated). RoundedDifferentialTests.DivideGivingRounded_ModeIs is a hand-derived AssertOutput, not a legacy differential. CONFORMS-but-partly-untested is legitimate under ground rule 3, and I state the residue precisely: Format 1's identifier-2-as-dividend and Format 4's INTO-as-dividend mappings are CODE-READ ONLY — I grepped the whole spec-derived corpus (`grep -rn DIVIDE tests/conformance --include=*.cob | grep -vi giving`) and the ONLY Format-1 DIVIDEs are `DIVIDE 2 INTO SMALL` in tests/conformance/85/phrase_order_arithmetic.cob and optional_on_size_error.cob, NEITHER of which displays SMALL (their .out files carry only DIV-NOT). No corpus program writes Format 4 (INTO … GIVING … REMAINDER) at all — pb84's three REMAINDER rows are all BY. A `DIVIDE 2 INTO SMALL / DISPLAY SMALL` golden and a Format-4 golden would upgrade the evidence.
